target.title: refactor: consolidate string reader mechanics
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Closes #99663.

The shared-utility audit found repeated mechanics for caller-owned string enums and first-string alias selection. Core callers separately implemented exact membership checks, raw alias reads, and trimmed non-empty alias reads, which made return contracts easy to blur and repeated casts/loops across unrelated owners.

Search proof for this coherent slice:

- Exact option readers repeated `typeof value === "string"` plus array/set membership and narrowing casts.
- Alias readers repeated ordered loops with two distinct contracts: preserve whitespace/empty strings, or trim and skip empty strings.
- The final slice consolidates 15 core caller modules; plugin/package callers remain local because exposing these mechanics through normalization-core or the plugin SDK increases the enforced public surface and is not required by external callers.
- Remaining near-matches stay local when they return the matched key, collect multiple values, preserve different whitespace semantics, or combine domain defaults/policy.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds one internal owner at `src/utils/string-readers.ts` for three dependency-free mechanics:

- `isStringOption` narrows against caller-owned arrays or sets.
- `readStringAlias` preserves whitespace and empty strings.
- `readTrimmedStringAlias` returns the first trimmed non-empty alias.

Domain enum values, normalization order, defaults, fallbacks, and side effects stay local. The implementation intentionally adds no package dependency, normalization-core export, plugin SDK facade, config/default surface, or compatibility shim.

The final branch changes 15 production callers plus the internal implementation and tests. Production code is `+89/-97`, net **-8 LOC**.

## User Impact

No intended user-visible behavior change. Core maintainers get one typed implementation for exact option narrowing and ordered alias selection while plugins, packages, config, protocol, storage, and defaults retain their prior contracts.

## Evidence

- Exact failed CI proof repaired: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts src/utils/string-readers.test.ts` — 10/10 tests passed; public SDK surface budgets remain pinned.
- Focused caller proof: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/utils/string-readers.test.ts src/acp/approval-classifier.test.ts src/agents/mcp-transport-config.test.ts src/infra/net/proxy-env.test.ts src/infra/outbound/message-action-runner.context.test.ts src/infra/outbound/message-action-runner.send-validation.test.ts src/infra/provider-usage.fetch.minimax.test.ts src/sessions/input-provenance.test.ts src/talk/consult-question.test.ts` — 170/170 tests passed across four shards.
- Changed gate: delegated Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwn4kq00zve3zgf7z8egwk92` — `check:changed` passed, including core/extensions typechecks, lint, dependency pin guard, database-first guard, and import-cycle guard. Actions: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28687576827
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Final autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings, confidence 0.97.
